name: 土壤有机质含量估算器

map.基于灼烧失重法(烧失法)估算土壤有机质与有机碳含量: Estimate soil organic matter and organic carbon by the ignition-loss method
map.📖 查看「土壤有机质含量估算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Soil Organic Matter Estimator Guide"
map.烧失率 = (烧前重 − 烧后重) ÷ 烧前重 × 100%；有机碳 = 烧失率: Loss rate = (pre-weight - post-weight) / pre-weight x 100%; organic carbon = loss rate x temperature correction (400C 0.50 / 550C 0.58 / other 0.65); organic matter = organic carbon x conversion factor
map.灼烧失重法：先求烧失率，再乘温度校正系数得有机碳。烧失量中部分为结构水等非有机质: Ignition-loss method: first loss rate, then times temperature correction for organic carbon. Part of the loss is structural water and other non-organic loss, so correct by ignition temperature (550C standard 0.58). Organic matter = organic carbon x conversion factor (van Bemmelen 1.724), graded (very deficient to very rich) with fertility advice.
map.📚 深度解析：土壤有机质含量估算器: 📚 Deep Dive: Soil Organic Matter Estimator
map.有机质（重铬酸钾法）= 消耗氧化剂量折算 × 常数 / 土样干重。: Organic matter (dichromate method) = oxidant consumed x constant / dry soil weight.
map.烧失法仅粗估，含无机误差。: The ignition method only estimates roughly, with inorganic error.
map.用于耕地质量等级与培肥评价。: Used for arable quality grading and fertility evaluation.
map.风干土 0.5000 g 经重铬酸钾外加热法滴定，折算有机碳 5.8%，乘以系数: Air-dried soil 0.5000 g by dichromate external-heating titration gives organic carbon 5.8%, times 1.724 = organic matter about 10.0%. A typical fertile black soil; keep straw return to maintain it.
map.有机质和有机碳怎么换算？: How to convert organic matter and organic carbon?
map.经验系数 1.724（有机质≈有机碳×1.724，假设有机质含碳 58%）。这是: The empirical factor 1.724 (organic matter = organic carbon x 1.724, assuming 58% carbon). A long-used conversion; actual varies by soil.
map.秸秆还田、增施有机肥/农家肥、种植绿肥、减少深耕扰动。是慢过程，数年才显效，需持: Straw return, more manure / farmyard manure, green manure, less deep-till disturbance. A slow process, years to show, needs continuity.
map.土壤有机质含量估算器是一款农业种植领域的在线工具。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数: The Soil Organic Matter Estimator is an online agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
